# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (turns sixty-one during the story).
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased (dies of a sudden heart shock caused by the failure of the Abbey Bank).
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island
- **Role:** Farmer at Green Gables
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband (applied mockingly to his quiet demeanor in town)

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking, stooping man with an ungainly figure and long iron-gray hair that reaches his shoulders. He has worn a full, soft brown beard since he was twenty years old.

## Personality

Matthew is notoriously quiet, gentle, and the shyest man alive, deeply fearing strangers and dreading all women except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Despite his silent nature, he possesses an extraordinary, quiet persistency when he sets his mind on something. He is intensely sympathetic, soft-hearted, and generous, quickly becoming Anne's gentlest confidant and advocate.

## Traits

- Extremely shy and reclusive
- Fear of women and strange girls
- Silent persistency
- Generous and indulgently kind

## Abilities

- Farming and physical farm labor

## Goals

- To keep and indulge Anne Shirley, ensuring her happiness and providing for her future and education

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet, unmarried life at Green Gables alongside his sister Marilla. Due to advancing age and heart trouble, he agreed to adopt a young orphan boy to assist with farm work, but drove to Bright River station to discover that an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley, had been sent by mistake. Intrigued and charmed by her ceaseless chatter on the drive home, Matthew quietly insisted to Marilla that they keep her. Over the next four years, he continuously championed and spoiled Anne, giving her sweetmeats and secretly buying her a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas. When Anne won the prestigious Avery Scholarship at Queen's Academy, Matthew expressed his deep pride in her. Shortly after her graduation, Matthew collapsed and died instantaneously at the threshold of Green Gables after reading a newspaper announcement detailing the catastrophic failure of the Abbey Bank, where all his savings were kept.

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Green Gables, built by his shy and silent father on the furthest edge of cleared land in Avonlea
- Has suffered from heart trouble for a long time
